# Shared instance of the test factory

<small>Source: [`R/test_factory.R`](https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/heteroTests/blob/main/R/test_factory.R) · Help: `?test_factory`</small>

Users can register new tests via this object. Built-in tests are
pre-registered at package load time.

## Details

Deprecated since 0.14.0, with [TestFactory](TestFactory.md): it leaves the exports in
1.0.0, and as an object it cannot warn when used. Use
[`registerDiagnostic()`](registerDiagnostic.md) and [`runHeteroTests()`](runHeteroTests.md) instead.
